title: 第1269章 四阶天仙神火第1268章 天仙大能紫火兽皇
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
血影分身大法！
嗖、嗖嗖嗖……
李青元双手捏诀，《杀道血神经》瞬间催动，仙力分化，血煞凝聚，上百血影分身同时诞生，各自遁走。
每一具分身都有着与李青元一模一样的气息、修为、法则波动。
在兽群的感知中，一百个血色人影朝一百个方向逃窜，真假难辨。
两头真仙巅峰紫火金晶兽怒吼，分别扑向最近的分身，利爪撕裂虚空，一爪拍下，分身如泡沫般碎裂，却只是血影分身罢了。
五头真仙后期紫火金晶兽分散追杀，渡劫期兽潮更是蜂拥而至，紫火光柱交织，封锁四方，分身一个接一个被轰碎。
几个呼吸后，折损一半血影分身后，李青元成功逃出兽群包围圈，分身消散，真身遁地而走。
吼！
真仙巨兽怒吼，渡劫期兽群疯狂追杀。
然而，九转玄功、五行大遁，更有通天建木道基模拟万法、万物气息。
李青元可以化作一块石头、一棵树木、可以融入溪流、可以融入地火。
九转玄功护体，完美隐藏气息。
以我如今的修为，除非天仙元神一寸一寸横扫四方，地毯式搜魂，不然绝不会露出马脚。
我只需小心天仙兽皇。
先让他们和兽群斗，相互搏杀，相互消耗。
我最后出手，借助杨小禾之力，一击必杀。
赵星辰三位半步天仙为首，当机立断：立刻分散突围，不可让兽群包围彻底合拢。
二十六个真仙修士中，只有一个真仙中期圆满，其余都是真仙后期、真仙巅峰，三个半步天仙。
同阶一战，半步天仙可以压制兽王，因为兽王终究不是真正的生灵，只是空有半步天仙修为罢了，没有神通、没有法宝。

不过，真仙级兽群终究数量多，以多击少，辅助数万渡劫期兽潮相助，慢慢将外来修士包围起来。
更何况还陨落了两个真仙后期，战力又折损不少。
兽皇庞大身躯对着虚空嗅了嗅，天仙兽皇的感知远超真仙，已非寻常仙识可比，而是接近天仙元神的本能直觉。
它嗅到了，那股令它数百万年魂牵梦萦的气息。
然而……南明朱雀神火的气息，消失了。
兽皇勃然大怒：南明离火呢？
本座的南明离火呢？
杀、给我杀了他们。
本座要炼化他们的尸体。
吼！
兽群得令，方圆几百万里，皆为兽潮。
赵星辰等人当机立断：杀出去。
灵宠、符箓、傀儡、阵法、一次性特殊杀伤性法宝全都扔出。
十几张二阶仙品符箓化作各色光芒，火海雷狱冰域交织。
三具玄兵傀儡以品字形冲阵，万丈金人拳轰脚踢，力大无穷。
青蛇大妖，真仙后期，喷吐毒雾，巨尾绞杀。
修士们全力出手，他们的本命法宝与强大神通配合，直接冲散半步天仙兽王合围之势，全力突围。
一名真仙巅峰修士祭出阵盘，三阶仙阵瞬间展开，光芒笼罩方圆数万里。
content_en:
Blood shadow clone method!
Whoosh, whoosh whoosh whoosh...
Li Qingyuan kneaded the secret with both hands, and activated the "Killing Blood Nerve" instantly. The immortal power was divided, the blood evil was condensed, and hundreds of blood shadow clones were born at the same time, and each of them escaped.
Each clone has the same aura, cultivation, and law fluctuations as Li Qingyuan.
In the perception of the beasts, a hundred bloody figures fled in a hundred directions, and it was difficult to distinguish the true from the false.
The two purple fire gold crystal beasts at the peak of the True Immortal roared and pounced on the nearest clone respectively. Their sharp claws tore through the void and struck down with one claw. The clones shattered like bubbles, but they were only blood shadow clones.
The five purple-fire golden crystal beasts in the late True Immortal Stage dispersed to pursue them, and the beasts in the Tribulation Stage swarmed in. The purple fire light beams intertwined and blocked all directions, and the clones were blasted to pieces one by one.
After a few breaths and half of his blood shadow clone was broken, Li Qingyuan successfully escaped from the encirclement of the beasts. The clone dissipated and his true body escaped.
roar!
The giant beasts of the True Immortal roared furiously, and the beasts in the Tribulation Period chased and killed them crazily.
However, the Nine Revolutions Mysterious Technique, the Five Elements Escape, and the Heaven-Bearing Wooden Dao Foundation simulate all laws and the breath of all things.
Li Qingyuan can turn into a stone, a tree, merge into streams, and merge into earth fire.
The nine-turn mysterious power protects the body and hides the breath perfectly.
With my current level of cultivation, unless the Heavenly Immortal Soul sweeps across all directions inch by inch, searching for souls like a carpet, the trap will never be revealed.
I only need to be careful of the Celestial Beast King.
First let them fight with the beasts, fight each other, and consume each other.
I made the last move, and with the help of Yang Xiaohe, I killed him with one blow.
Led by the three half-step immortals Zhao Xingchen, they made a decisive decision: they immediately dispersed and broke out, and the beasts could not be completely surrounded and closed up.
Among the twenty-six True Immortal monks, only one has reached the middle stage of True Immortal, and the rest are late stage True Immortal, peak True Immortal, and three half-step Heavenly Immortals.
In a battle of the same level, a half-step immortal can suppress the Beast King, because after all, the Beast King is not a real living being, he just has the cultivation level of a half-step immortal, without magical powers or magic weapons.
However, after all, the herd of true immortal beasts was large in number. With more attacks and fewer attacks, tens of thousands of beasts in the Tribulation Stage were assisted to help, slowly surrounding the foreign monks.
What's more, two late-stage true immortals also died, and their combat power was greatly reduced.
The Beast King sniffed the void with his huge body. The perception of the Celestial Beast King was far beyond that of a true immortal. It was no longer comparable to ordinary immortal knowledge, but was close to the instinctive intuition of the Celestial Spirit.
It smelled the scent that had haunted it for millions of years.
However... the aura of Nanming's Vermillion Bird Divine Fire disappeared.
The Beast King was furious: Where is Nanming Lihuo?
Where is my Nanming Lihuo?
Kill, kill them for me.
I want to refine their corpses.
roar!
Once the beast herd is ordered, there will be a tide of beasts all over millions of miles.
Zhao Xingchen and others made a quick decision: get out.
Spiritual pets, talismans, puppets, formations, and one-time special destructive magic weapons were all thrown out.
More than a dozen second-level immortal talismans turned into various colors of light, and the sea of ​​fire, thunder and ice intertwined.
Three Xuanbing puppets charged into the formation in the shape of a pin, and the ten thousand-foot-long golden man punched and kicked with infinite power.
The great green snake demon, in the late stage of true immortality, spits poisonous mist and strangles with its giant tail.
The monks took action with all their strength, using their natal magic weapons and powerful supernatural powers to directly break away the half-step encirclement of the Celestial Beast King and break through with all their strength.
A cultivator at the peak of True Immortal sacrificed the formation disk, and the third-order Immortal Formation instantly unfolded, covering tens of thousands of miles with light.
